stories.title: Prosecutors intend to seek death penalty in murder of 18-year-old in Tolleson
stories.summary: 28-year-old Randal Basilio Santillan is facing charges of first-degree murder and kidnapping in the death of 18-year-old Yessenia Norman.

stories.title: Child in 'critical condition' after Mesa police respond to drowning call
stories.summary: The incident was reported Tuesday in a neighborhood near Baseline and Signal Butte roads.

stories.title: Grand Canyon hotels will reopen as water access is restored
stories.summary: Overnight lodging will resume at facilities in the South Rim of the Grand Canyon on Nov. 20.

stories.title: Pedestrian dead after hit by car in south Phoenix, police say
stories.summary: A man was killed after being struck by a vehicle near 19th Avenue and Baseline Road on Tuesday.

stories.title: Teen girl, 16, killed in central Phoenix crash after crossing 7th Street midblock
stories.summary: 7th Street was closed south of Thomas Road to Windsor Avenue as police investigated a deadly car-pedestrian crash.

stories.title: A missing 2-year-old has been located after a multi-agency search in Pinal County, southwest of Eloy
stories.summary: The Pinal County Sheriff's Office said the little girl was located and is safe.

stories.title: Water main leak shuts down stretch of Phoenix roads
stories.summary: Traffic restrictions are expected as crews investigate a leak that may involve a 20-inch water main near 7th Avenue and Dobbins Road.

stories.title: Absolute perfection! Sunshine during the day, a few clouds and cool temps at night
stories.summary: By Friday a cold system will brush the northern parts of Arizona bringing a mix of rain and snow above 6500'

stories.title: Arizona proposes 2 potential locations for new U.S. Space Academy
stories.summary: Arizona is one of about a dozen applicants wanting to be the home of the brand new academy.

stories.title: 2 boys taken to the hospital after being hit while riding their dirt bike
stories.summary: Phoenix Police said they were hit by a vehicle near 39th Avenue and Roosevelt Street.

stories.title: Scottsdale Unified School District approves its first arts magnet school
stories.summary: The school will open at the Echo Canyon Campus.

stories.title: Gilbert’s Ocotillo Bridge opens in December, with a special opportunity for pedestrians to walk across before it opens to vehicles
stories.summary: The town of Gilbert will debut the Ocotillo Bridge on December 1 that will now connect communities across the Gilbert Regional Park.
